<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="מנחם אב_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919814_theRebbe_260" batchId="meluket-_D7_9E_D7_A0_D7_97_D7_9D_20_D7_90_D7_91_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919814_theRebbe_260__p007">
  <section v="18">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section expresses the hope that through our efforts to not be affected by trials, the future redemption will be hastened, including the ingathering of exiles and the building of the Holy Temple.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And may it be His will,</t>
    <t s="1">that through our deeds and our service</t>
    <t s="2">of not being affected by all the trials,</t>
    <t s="3">including also such trials that according to all calculations</t>
    <t s="4">(even from the aspect of the elevation that is in the service of trials)</t>
    <t s="5">there is no rationale for this,</t>
    <t s="6">they will bring closer and hasten even more the future redemption through our righteous Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="7">who will wage</t>
    <t s="8">the wars of G-d and will be victorious</t>
    <t s="9">[Most of these wars have no place in intellect,</t>
    <t s="10">nor even in the intellect of the warriors,</t>
    <t s="11">therefore,</t>
    <t s="12">the wars are with great force,</t>
    <t s="13">and nevertheless he will be victorious],</t>
    <t s="14">and he will build the Holy Temple in its place,</t>
    <t s="15">and he will gather the dispersed of Israel,</t>
    <t s="16">including that he will gather all the sparks of holiness</t>
    <t s="17">and also the dispersed of Israel in their simple sense—the ingathering of the exiles,</t>
    <t s="18">very soon,</t>
    <t s="19">in the true and complete redemption through our righteous Moshiach.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
